name: AMD RDNA 3
notes: AMD RX 7900 series - RDNA 3 architecture, subgroups, F16. Routing alias: adapters reporting RDNA 3.5 (Strix Point, Strix Halo, Krackan; Doe reports 'rdna-3.5' for those PCI IDs, Dawn reports 'rdna-3') share this profile, so both runtimes select the same kernels on the same hardware.
